observation: Viewed front, top and iso once. Mint front half remains connected, with centered incoming ball and symmetric open ankle corners. The new parent-clearance boundary leaves a broad thin crescent across the front land; the ball underside meets a recessed clearance pocket. Numeric checks locate a 279.3 mm2 wall region below 1.2 mm and a 3.5 mm2 unsupported region near the ball root.
